title: Structs and mutating methods
summary: Keep a value type encapsulated with private(set) and update stored properties in mutating methods.
triggers: a struct owns state that callers may read but must not change directly
prompts: Count positive steps and expose a reset operation without allowing arbitrary external writes.
invariant: The step count stays nonnegative and changes only through the struct methods.
pitfalls: Methods that change struct properties need mutating.
A let binding prevents mutation of the entire struct value.
